
Each harness exports its telemetry wherever its MDM-managed settings direct it, and that telemetry lands in ClickStack's ClickHouse (WL-REQ-1234). `lode install` sets `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY=true`, so Claude Code's metrics and events carry the session repository's `vcs.*` attributes (WL-REQ-36). Worklode reads token usage from ClickHouse: Claude Code's `claude_code.token.usage` metrics and Codex's response log records, normalized into the usage classes Worklode accepts, deduplicated on raw provider identity and attributed to a session's task by WL-REQ-1730. Worklode prices tokens from effective-dated `model_prices` rows, never from `claude_code.cost.usage`. Export failure never blocks the agent; a ClickHouse failure leaves usage unreported until the next read.
